_comments.name: Full name of the PWA shown to users.
_comments.short_name: Short name used where space is limited.
_comments.start_url: URL that should be opened when the app is launched.
_comments.display: How the app is displayed; 'standalone' removes browser UI.
_comments.background_color: Background color used while the app is loading.
_comments.theme_color: Theme color for the OS UI (status bar, task switcher).
_comments.icons: List of app icons in various sizes used for shortcuts and homescreen.
_comments._comments: This object contains human-readable descriptions and is ignored by browsers. It's added here solely for developer reference.
